newsitem.title: MALAWI: MALAWI HOTEL GROUP SECOND TO LIST ON STOCK MARKET.
newsitem.headline: MALAWI HOTEL GROUP SECOND TO LIST ON STOCK MARKET.

text.p: Malawi's second largest hotel group Blantyre Hotels Ltd (BHL) plans to list 2.9 million ordinary shares on the Malawi Stock Exchange (MSE) on Monday, the daily Nation newspaper said.

It said the move would make BHL the second company to list on the exchange. The first to list was the country's biggest insurance company, National Insurance Company, which made its debut in the primary market in November last year, with a market capitalisation of around $15 million.
Stockbrokers Malawi head Rob Stangroom said in December he expected five companies to be listed on the small exchange by the end of 1997, particularly sugar companies.
